PRIVACY

Your details.
Handled with clarity.

This page explains how your information is handled when you use the Carnival Studios website and contact the studio.

Preparing an enquiry

The enquiry form uses the name, occasion, date, venue, service and message you enter to prepare a WhatsApp message. Your draft stays in your browser while this page is open. This website does not submit it to an inbox or database, or save it in browser storage.

Contacting us on WhatsApp

When you choose “Continue to WhatsApp”, your message is passed to WhatsApp. Review it and press Send there to contact Carnival Studios. Information you send can be used by the studio to respond to your enquiry and discuss your event. Copying a draft places it on your device’s clipboard; copying alone does not send it.

External services

WhatsApp and Instagram are external services with their own privacy practices. Opening their links takes you away from this website. Website hosting and access providers may process technical information needed to deliver and protect the site, such as request details and IP addresses.

Analytics and storage

This website does not include advertising trackers, third-party analytics or embedded social media feeds. It does not store your enquiry draft in cookies or local storage. Your browser and any external services you choose to use may handle information separately.

Privacy questions

For questions about information you have shared with Carnival Studios, contact the studio on +91 98522 48522 or message us on WhatsApp. Please avoid including sensitive personal details in an initial enquiry.
